meta.note: One record per deal/instrument. Bases are explicit per record (size_basis): face, gross, net, facility, commitment, reported. Announced/committed/reported items carry in_totals=false and are NEVER summed with priced/closed deals. Non-USD deals carry size_usd_bn only where a source gives the USD equivalent (Barclays at-issue or 10-Q carrying value, stated). Project bonds are keyed by the TENANT ticker (issuer named in 'issuer'); roster=false rows are adjacent issuers kept for the pricing map. Credit marks quoted in notes are the official AI_Credit_Live workbook bases: price pts, YTM %, OAS bp (Bloomberg, 2026-11-03 09:34). Boundary rows (window_flag) are listed; only 'boundary-in' rows count in totals.
